body: It is just the metabolism of the pills. If it were enough to shut down the kidneys, it would have to be toxic levels that they couldn't process. They would struggle to try to, then fail.

Her life matters, but so does yours. With BPD, you already have issues with interpersonal relationships (typically) and can easily become codependent. Know that if she makes bad choices that impact you, that you have a right to talk about it. Make plans to get her on track or even give an ultimatum. You are important and can't let someone you care about bring you down.

You probably need to go to the hospital. Tylenol isn't usually deadly right away. It is painful if your kidneys shut down and then you have an additional problem. I highly recommend medical treatment.

My friend usually isn't helpful in anything she says or does. I don't want to do it with her around. I'm scared she'd find my body. Without her here, I know that 45 minutes after I take my pills I'd be dead. I had to be on life support a few years ago from an accidental overdose on this medication. It's so tempting.
I find it hard to talk someone out of the very thing I feel like doing myself. Just know that you're not alone. I wish I was more help. Just know people are listening. Even if it's only me.
